name: Ubuntu OpenPGP keyserver (Hockeypuck, HKP machine-readable index)
tier_rationale: Established company running a public keyserver with published terms and a privacy policy (A8 trusted): 'Canonical's keyserver is trusted' (P091 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: SKS-lineage keyserver: anyone can upload a key with any user ID, so UIDs are unverified self-published claims (P091 cond 3); fingerprints and creation dates are cryptographic facts of the uploaded key.

hkp_index.title: HKP machine-readable index (GET https://keyserver.ubuntu.com/pks/lookup?op=index&options=mr&search=<address | org domain | 0x<fingerprint>>)

terms.quote: Tier community (keys.openpgp.org; Canonical's keyserver is trusted); terms open.

hkp_index.notes: Research C0210 (verified_live 200/404). Lines info:/pub:/uid: (uid %-escaped). No result = 404 text/plain 'Not Found' ('no key published on keyserver.ubuntu.com', never 'no such person', P091 cond 7). Hockeypuck caps the count at 100 ('info:1:100') and may list fewer keys than it declares: results are flagged capped. UIDs whose self-signatures expired are hidden (pub line without uid lines). Never cached (ttl 0): the raw index of a search holds other people's UIDs and minimisation depends on the investigated value (P091 cond 4). 1 MB cap (P091 cond 2). pgp.mit.edu (timed out) and keyserver.pgp.com (redundant) are not used (P091 cond 1). Used by pgp_keyservers.
